H1 (Restatements/Corrections): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. There is no evidence of material restatements or corrections to Services revenue figures that would alter the reported 16% growth rate.

The retrieved evidence discusses general litigation settlements and privacy compliance but does not provide specific information about one-time items or non-recurring revenue affecting Services in Q2 2026. The absence of such disclosure does not support the challenge.

H3 (Category definition changes): CHALLENGE_REFUTED. Evidence E18 shows the Services category consistently includes "amortization of the deferred value of services bundled in the sales price of certain products" across multiple periods, indicating consistent definition. Evidence E10 mentions only presentation reclassifications, not substantive category changes.
